items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: So I called Monestier and told him, said you can get ready to send me back home

ctx.x: That's right, that was the trouble in Micahel's. He played them -- he had that fiddle so damned loud.

So I told McShann, I spoke to him first, then I spoke to Fiddler, and I said, you don't really have to play that loud. I said, I don't know what the problems are here, but I think we all are supposed to be a team, and not one guy walk off as the individual god of this thing. We're going to have to make it as a unit. So I called Monestier and told him, said you can get ready to send me back home, because if the guys are not going to team, I don't want to be here. And somehow they got him to come down. McShann was…
body else, what he wanted played, you know.
